AIQIF-C2.1.F1.text: The institution issued guidance that explicitly governs AI use for an identifiable group or activity, and the evidence establishes when it was in effect.

evidence_parts.ai_guidance: AI-use rules naming the covered group or activity, such as acceptable-use or academic integrity guidance.
evidence_parts.effective_status: An effective date, adoption notice or equivalent evidence that those rules took effect.

AIQIF-C2.1.F1.evidence_link_rule: Match the adoption or effective record to the same guidance version and covered group or activity. A dated draft or publication date alone is insufficient.

AIQIF-C2.1.A1.text: A completed deployment or onboarding check records how a specific AI policy requirement was applied to an identified AI use.

evidence_parts.policy_requirement: The specific AI policy provision applied, in the policy text or recorded by the check.
evidence_parts.ai_deployment: The named AI system, use, deployment or onboarding activity.
evidence_parts.completed_policy_check: A dated completed checklist, review or sign-off describing the application of that provision.

AIQIF-C2.1.A1.evidence_link_rule: Connect the provision and the completed check to the same AI use and period. A blank checklist or generic IT sign-off is insufficient.

AIQIF-C6.1.O1.text: A completed review compares measured performance of an identified computing service with a stated capacity or availability target for a compatible period.

evidence_parts.service_measurement: Measured capacity or availability for the named service, with units and period.
evidence_parts.service_target: A stated capacity or availability target, such as an SLA or capacity plan.
evidence_parts.service_comparison: A completed review recording the comparison, regardless of whether the service met the target.

AIQIF-C6.1.O1.evidence_link_rule: Match the service, metric, units and applicable period. A chart and an unrelated target are insufficient.

AIQIF-C9.4.A2.text: A completed check records whether an identified corrective action was carried out.

evidence_parts.corrective_action: The specific corrective action, such as an action-register entry.
evidence_parts.completion_check: A dated verification, closure entry or follow-up minute recording whether the action was carried out.

AIQIF-C9.4.A2.evidence_link_rule: Match the completion check to the action by identifier or an unambiguous description. Assignment, a due date or a bare closed status does not establish a check.

AIQIF-C9.4.O1.text: A completed follow-up review evaluates what happened after an identified change made in response to feedback.

evidence_parts.feedback_finding: The feedback finding that prompted the change.
evidence_parts.implemented_change: A record that the identified change was implemented in response to that feedback.
evidence_parts.subsequent_result: A completed follow-up review, measurement or survey evaluating the subsequent result.

AIQIF-C9.4.O1.evidence_link_rule: Match the initiative and change across records and establish feedback, implementation and subsequent review in order. A separate survey or implementation check alone is insufficient. A formal control group is optional.
